d:
Filipins ki rajdhani manila men mangalvar ko kvad deshon ke shirsh netaon ka shikhar sammelan aayojit huaa. ismen kvad deshon ke shirsh neta shamil hue, lekin is samit ki charcha kisi aur vajah se ho rahi hai. vo hai charon netaon ka foto seshan aur is dauran piem modi ka tranp ko tokna. dekhie ye riport.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
